title: A Posteriori Second-Order Guarantees for Bolza Problems via Collocation
summary: Direct collocation for Bolza optimal control yields discrete Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points, while practical solvers expose only discrete quantities such as primal-dual iterates, reduced Hessians, and Jacobians. This creates a gap between continuous second-order optimality theory and what can be certified from solver output. We develop an a posteriori certification framework that bridges this gap. Starting from a discrete KKT solution, we reconstruct piecewise polynomial state, control, and costate trajectories, evaluate residuals of the dynamics, boundary, and stationarity conditions, and…
